notes:
Lead: Helena Cho (CTO) + Eng manager Derek Ngo. Evaluating Redwood as backend for HelixSnippet VS Code extension (shipping Q3). Primary ask: streaming inline suggestions with <50ms median token latency for completions in small files and ~100ms tail for large files. Must support model pinning per-release (team wants to pin to a quantized 1.3 variant while testing 1.4 in parallel).

Key product requirements:
- Streaming completion API w/ chunked tokens and resumable streams. Inline suggestions must insert without blocking editor.
- Per-developer rate limits & API keys, allow org-level quotas, graceful throttling (429 -> local fallback to cached completions).
- Prefix/KV caching to avoid re-sending full repo contexts; ability to store K/V in-region.
- Audit logs and per-request metadata for GDPR purposes.
- SSO (SAML) + SCIM for provisioning.
- Optional on-prem agent for air-gapped customers later (not required for initial POC).

Security notes: Supports SOC2 but need details on KMS/HSM, key rotation, and retention controls. "We cannot allow whole-file uploads; only tokenized context or local fingerprinting" (Helena).

Commercial: prefer hosted for time-to-market but want a path to Dedicated reserved capacity once user base grows (30k MAU). Cost sensitivity around tokens for background indexing/embeddings — will explore Redwood Optimize recommendations.

Quotes/Call snippets:
- "If latency >50ms users will turn completions off" — Eng manager Derek Ngo.
- "Need ability to pin stable model for stable UX during release" — PM Lina Park.

POC plan: 2-week perf POC on Dedicated pool (or hosted warm instance) with sample VS Code flow: open file -> type -> see streaming suggestion -> accept/modify. Measure median & 95th latency, token costs.

Docs/Artifacts: security questionnaire in drive, demo recording (ff-20260218-helixsnippet-demo-01). Next: SE to run perf script and share perf matrix; procurement wants pricing scenario for 100k monthly tokens and burst allowances.
